protagonist.name: Anya
protagonist.description: a high school student with braided hair, wearing a green hoodie

video_prompts.prompt: Wide shot of a dark, empty space with a single horizontal line of light. Anya, a high school student with braided hair, wearing a green hoodie, watches. Glowing blue points representing integers appear on the line. Then, smaller yellow points representing rational numbers rapidly fill the gaps between them. Finally, a fine, shimmering silver dust representing irrational numbers flows in, connecting all points into a solid, continuous, white-hot beam of light. The camera slowly dollies forward along the line's length, showing its new solidity. The final frame is a close-up on a segment of the glowing line, showing no gaps at all, representing the completeness of real numbers.

High-angle shot in a minimalist workshop. Anya, a high school student with braided hair, wearing a green hoodie, stands before a large, complex geometric crystal representing the number 32760. The crystal is made of interlocking, semi-transparent parts. She touches its surface, and it fractures with a soft chime. The pieces separate and reassemble into neat stacks of smaller, primary-colored crystals: three red cubes (2s), two blue pyramids (3s), one yellow sphere (5), one green dodecahedron (7), and one purple icosahedron (13). The camera orbits the sorted prime crystals, showing they are the fundamental components. The final frame shows the unique set of prime crystals, illustrating the Fundamental Theorem of Arithmetic.

Eye-level shot in a digital workspace. Anya, a high school student with braided hair, wearing a green hoodie, observes two holographic chains of colored blocks. One chain represents 180 (two red blocks, two blue, one yellow). The other represents 308 (two red blocks, one green, one purple). Anya gestures, and the non-matching blocks fade to grey. Only the two red blocks (representing 2^2) remain brightly lit in both chains. These common blocks are then extracted and link together in the center. The camera pushes in slowly on the newly formed short chain. The final frame is a close-up of the two linked red blocks, labeled 'HCF = 4', showing the product of common primes with the lowest power.

Medium shot in the same digital workspace. Anya, a high school student with braided hair, wearing a green hoodie, again views the two holographic chains for 180 and 308. This time, she gestures, and a new construction area appears. Copies of all unique block types from both chains fly into the new area: two red blocks, two blue, one yellow, one green, and one purple. The blocks connect in a sequence, forming a single, long, multi-colored chain. The camera performs a smooth crane shot, rising to show the full length of the new, combined chain. The final frame is an aerial view of the long chain, labeled 'LCM = 27720', representing the product of all primes with the highest powers.

Close-up on a delicate, polished brass balance scale in a dimly lit room. Anya, a high school student with braided hair, wearing a green hoodie, watches intently. On the left pan, a container is labeled 'p²'. On the right, two identical containers are labeled 'q²'. She places two glowing orbs into the 'p²' container, making it perfectly balanced. This forces her to place one orb in each 'q²' container. However, a rule flashes in the air: 'p and q cannot both be even'. The orbs representing 'p' and 'q' both pulse with a red light, and the scale tips dramatically, breaking the balance. The camera zooms into the unbalanced scale. The final frame shows the broken equilibrium, a visual metaphor for the proof by contradiction.
